_note: menfacialwash (master_menfacialwash_id) shares facialfoam's taxonomy tables: dict=facialfoam.facialfoam_dict, qa=facialfoam.product_id_dict_qa, filter=facialfoam.filter_facialfoam_id. Pattern inferred 2026-09-09 from 4333 live facialfoam_dict rows and is identical to dict_patterns/facialfoam.json; keep the two in sync. facialfoam_dict has NO _meta column and bundle_quantity is INT64 (write bare 1, not '1').

packsize.note: packsize = '<gramasi> <satuan>' (e.g. '100 ml', '50 gr'). Multipacks stay bundle_type='single' and encode the count in packsize only, as '<size> <unit> x <N> pcs' (e.g. '100 gr x 2 pcs'), with gramasi/satuan holding the PER-UNIT size. Multi-item paket/bundle listings use the literal 'Set'; several-scent listings use 'Multi Variant'; several-size listings use 'Multi Size'. 29 rows legitimately have packsize='' (open-ended multi-variant identities such as 'Garnier Face Wash Multi Variant Facial Wash').

sku.note: sub_brand already carries the brand prefix (e.g. 'Pond's Men Brightening & Dark Spot', 'Kahf Skin Energizing & Brightening'), so brand is NOT concatenated again. categories is the noun on the pack: 'Facial Wash' (3361) or 'Facial Foam' (826). For packsize='Set' rows in brands whose analysts drop the noun (Clorismen), sku = sub_brand alone even though categories is populated.

sku_type_complete.note: Equivalently sub_brand + ' ' + categories + ' ' + packsize, skipping any empty source (never emit a literal 'null' or a dangling separator).

keywords.note: keywords is a verbatim copy of sku_type_complete on ~99% of rows.
